item.title: Killswitch Engage's JESSE LEACH Reflects On Tour Life: 'We Owe It To The Fans, Dude'
item.description: Killswitch Engage singer Jesse Leach opened up about the pressures of touring and how he protects his voice on the road. In a recent interview with American Musical Supply, Leach explained his routine for staying healthy and keeping his vocals in shape while traveling.

item.title: JESSE LEACH Talks About KILLSWITCH ENGAGE's 'Aftermath': 'We All Have a Responsibility'
item.description: Killswitch Engage isn’t wasting time with metaphors or feel-good slogans in their latest single. The video for “Aftermath” just dropped, and it doesn’t sugarcoat a thing. If you were expecting a fun, breakdown-heavy anthem about “staying strong,” keep scrolling.

item.title: KILLSWITCH ENGAGE Shares Music Video For 'Collusion' Single From 'This Consequence' Album
item.description: Killswitch Engage is back with This Consequence, their ninth studio album, and they’ve just unleashed a music video for the track “Collusion”, which, spoiler alert, is NOT about happy things.

item.title: Killswitch Engage’s Mike D’Antonio Rejects A.I. Claims: "I Don’t Wanna Be Associated With It"
item.description: Another day, another internet conspiracy theory—this time, aimed at Killswitch Engage bassist and graphic designer Mike D’Antonio, who’s had to crawl out of the art cave he’s been living in for the past eight months just to tell people to shut the hell up about A.
